invitations.subject: Resolving Data Architecture Roadblocks in Enterprise AI
invitations.preview_text: Bridging foundational data pipelines and machine learning scale.
invitations.body:
Hi {{Recipient.FirstName}},

Enterprise initiatives scaling generative models routinely stall when advanced algorithms encounter fragmented data pipelines and legacy database infrastructure. Industry research indicates that up to 60% of enterprise AI programs lacking structured data foundations face operational abandonment.

To address this execution challenge, Google Cloud is hosting Scale with AI: Live + Labs in Irvine on June 9, 2026, with 66degrees anchoring the technical partner demonstration showcase.

While your technical engineering leads validate live code in Google's hands-on sandboxes, 66degrees specialists will be available at our demonstration kiosk to help map those functional capabilities directly into your production architecture.

[Register for Scale with AI: Live + Labs]

Best regards,
The 66degrees Team
